# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
All incidents must be reviewed by management.
3. Add up the totals (columns and rows) of the calendar incident log.
4. All lost worked time cases will be listed.
5. Injuries from work related accidents occur when an employee is injured at work. Injuries from outside activities or at non-work locations should not be included, regardless of culpability. 
6. Enter each case of work injury by employee, cause, date, lost work days and type of accident for the year being reported.
7. Enter each case of 1st aid cases by employee, cause, date and type of accident for the year being reported.
8. The record should remain in the workplace for five years after the end of the year to which it pertains.
9. Some accidents produce more than one injury.
10. If unknown, leave blank.
